I can always tell when RealClearScience links to one of my posts about vaccines. In come a bunch of comments from people who know little or nothing about the subject and who assume that any favorable coverage must be propaganda.

But hey, it gets the posts out to people who wouldn't see them. . .

posts.text:
Here’s the ACS site with the feeds: 

pubs.acs.org/pages/rss

So earlier today I unloaded on the ACS for breaking all its RSS journal feeds in their recent redesign. But it turns out that they’re back - but how many people knew? They never got back to me about it.

But I can’t see the graphicsl abstracts on my RSS setup. Can you?
It would have been interesting to know where Nabokov's work would have gone had he continued to write in Russian. He often regretted having to abandon the language for his fiction.
I do believe that our hummingbirds have bailed out on us in the last two or three days. The males left first, and now I’m pretty sure the ladies are gone as well.
